items.title: fix(memory): large session exports exhaust workers (#196158)
items.summary: fix(memory): large session exports exhaust workers (#196158) fix(memory): keep large session exports under the worker memory limit One large session could make the memory-index session export worker exceed its 512 MB heap limit. The whole Gateway then aborted with exit 134 and the index stayed empty. The renderer now releases intermediate data while it exports, so peak memory stays under the limit. Exported content is unchanged. Evidence: a built Gateway in Docker on node:24.22.1 with no heap changes, using the reporter's own seed script (12,460 messages of 15 KB, about 178 MB of text), indexed through openclaw memory search. On main the Gateway aborted twice with exit 134 ("Reached heap limit"); the export worker was at about 615 to 622 MB. With this change the search succeeds twice on the same Gateway process, the session is fully indexed (236,702 chunks), both runs give identical rows, and the worker peaked at 436 to 494 MB. A small mixed session and an 8,000-message session give identical index rows on main and this change, and the 8,000-message chunks match the large export at the same positions. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196158#issuecomment-6749876072. check-lint-core-4 is an inherited max-lines red in six untouched files: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196158#issuecomment-6750460723 Thanks @ericcaiwx-star. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

Report a refresh claim as requiring authorization.

items.title: 展碁國際子公司好漾生活先行暫停線上商店營運，釐清線上商店委外業者Cyberbiz資安事件影響
items.summary: 11月6日上市電子通路業者展碁國際（6776）發布資安事件重大訊息，指出子公司好漾生活的線上商店委外服務廠商順立智慧（Cyberbiz），部分客戶發生資料庫部分資料遭未經授權存取事件，展碁國際得知此事後，持續關注事件發展，並與順立智慧保持聯繫，以釐清好漾生活

items.title: 諾貝兒線上商店委外廠商Cyberbiz資料庫遭異常存取，客戶訂單資料恐受影響
items.summary: 經營丁丁藥局的上櫃公司諾貝兒寶貝（6844）11月8日（週日）發布資安事件重大訊息，指出接獲線上商店委外服務廠商順立智慧（Cyberbiz）通知，其資料庫部分資料遭未經授權的異常存取，而該資料庫亦存有諾貝兒線上商店平臺的訂單相關資料，因此訂單資料可能受到影響。

items.title: Perplexity推出Teammates，支援多個常駐AI代理人分工協作
items.summary: 隨著科技業者相繼投入主動型AI代理人市場，Perplexity周三（11/4）宣布推出Teammates，讓使用者建立多個常駐AI代理人，各自負責長期專案，主動追蹤進度、執行任務，並互相交辦工作。
